items.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Abelian Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
items.informal_description: For any seminormed additive commutative group $E$, finite set $s$ of indices, and function $f : s \to E$, the norm of the sum of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$ is less than or equal to the sum of the norms of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$. Mathematically, this is expressed as $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\| \leq \sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|$.

items.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ a ∈ s, f a‖₊ ≤ ∑ a ∈ s, ‖f a‖₊
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $ and any function $ f : \iota \to E $ in a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, the non-negative norm of the sum $ \sum_{a \in s} f(a) $ is less than or equal to the sum of the non-negative norms of $ f(a) $, i.e., $ \left\| \sum_{a \in s} f(a) \right\|_+ \leq \sum_{a \in s} \| f(a) \|_+ $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Sum Bounded by Sum of Bounds in Seminormed Group
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → ℝ},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, functions $ f : \iota \to E $ and $ n : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, and a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, if $ \|f(b)\| \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\| \sum_{b \in s} f(b) \right\| \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_9} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  (f : ι → ε), ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ₑ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ₑ
items.informal_description: In a seminormed additive commutative monoid $\varepsilon$, for any finite set $s \subseteq \iota$ and function $f : \iota \to \varepsilon$, the extended norm of the sum $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_e$ is less than or equal to the sum of the extended norms $\sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_e$.

items.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_5} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) {f : ι → E} {n : ι → NNReal},
  (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖₊ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖₊ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $, a function $ f : s \to E $ into a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, and a function $ n : s \to \mathbb{R}_{\geq 0} $, if $ \|f(b)\|_+ \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\|\sum_{b \in s} f(b)\right\|_+ \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm of Sum is Bounded by Sum of Extended Norms
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_8} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
  {f : ι → ε} {n : ι → ENNReal}, (∀ b ∈ s, ‖f b‖ₑ ≤ n b) → ‖∑ b ∈ s, f b‖ₑ ≤ ∑ b ∈ s, n b
items.informal_description: For any finite set $ S $, a function $ f : S \to \varepsilon $ where $ \varepsilon $ is a seminormed additive commutative monoid, and a function $ n : S \to [0, \infty] $, if for all $ b \in S $ the extended norm $ \|f(b)\|_e \leq n(b) $, then the extended norm of the sum $ \left\|\sum_{b \in S} f(b)\right\|_e $ is less than or equal to the sum $ \sum_{b \in S} n(b) $.

items.type: ∀ {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (m : Multiset E), ‖m.sum‖ ≤ (Multiset.map (fun x => ‖x‖) m).sum
items.informal_description: For any multiset $ m $ in a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, the norm of the sum of the elements of $ m $ is less than or equal to the sum of the norms of the elements of $ m $, i.e., $\|\sum m\| \leq \sum_{x \in m} \|x\| $.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm of Multiset Sum is Less Than or Equal to Sum of Extended Norms
items.type:
∀ {ε : Type u_9} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (m : Multiset ε),
  ‖m.sum‖ₑ ≤ (Multiset.map (fun x => ‖x‖ₑ) m).sum
items.informal_description: For any multiset $ m $ over a seminormed additive commutative monoid $ \varepsilon $, the extended norm of the sum of the elements of $ m $ is less than or equal to the sum of the extended norms of the elements of $ m $, i.e., $ \| \sum m \|_e \leq \sum_{x \in m} \| x \|_e $.
